start.title: Setting Out
start.text:
Evening falls on the sea.
Jesus says, "Let us cross over."

choices.feedback: Mark 4:36 — The disciples took Jesus along with them in the boat as he was, just as they had been sailing.

refuse_consequence.title: Follow His Word
refuse_consequence.text:
His call is for tonight.
Go with him.

wait_consequence.title: Trust Him Now
wait_consequence.text:
He waits at the shore.
Delay nothing.

storm.title: The Sea Rises
storm.text:
Wind tears the sail.
Waves crash into the boat.

choices.feedback: Mark 4:37 — A great windstorm arose, and the waves were breaking into the boat, so that the boat was already filling.

curse_consequence.title: Hold Steady
curse_consequence.text:
Cursing will not still the storm.
Row with the others.

leap_consequence.title: Stay With Him
leap_consequence.text:
The sea would swallow you.
Return to the boat.

sleep.title: He Sleeps
sleep.text:
Jesus sleeps in the stern.
The storm grows fiercer.

choices.feedback: Mark 4:38 — The disciples woke Jesus, saying to him, "Teacher, do you not care that we are perishing?"

alone_consequence.title: Go To Him
alone_consequence.text:
You cannot save the boat alone.
Wake your Lord.

wake.title: Wake Him
wake.text:
What will you say?
The water rises fast.

choices.feedback: Matthew 8:25 — The disciples went and woke Jesus, saying, "Lord, save us! We are going to drown!"

blame_consequence.title: Ask, Don't Blame
blame_consequence.text:
He is not your enemy.
Ask him to save you.

silent_consequence.title: Cry To Him
silent_consequence.text:
Silence will not still the sea.
Speak.

calm.title: Peace, Be Still
calm.text:
He stands and lifts his hand.
"Peace. Be still."

choices.feedback: Mark 4:41 — The disciples were filled with great fear and said to one another, "Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?"

doubt_consequence.title: See and Believe
doubt_consequence.text:
The sea is glass.
Let awe fill you.

amaze.title: Who Is This?
amaze.text:
The sea is still.
"Even the wind obeys him."
